title: Warlite
description: A texture pack for SMP Gameplay
body:
Warlite-Improve your game

Enhance your Minecraft Survival Multiplayer experience with SMP Texture Pack! Designed for PvP and everyday survival, this pack features clean visuals, optimized textures, and improved item designs while keeping the classic Minecraft feel.

✨ Features

-Better Diamond Sword
-Better Netherite Sword
-Better Diamond Axe
-Better Netherite Axe
-Small Totem of Undying
-Ore Borders for easier mining
-Apple with Leaves (Enhanced Visuals)
-Clean & Minimal GUI
-PvP-friendly textures
-Vanilla-style look with improved quality

📦 Compatibility

- Minecraft: Java Edition
- Supported Versions: 1.21+ (Works with newer versions unless Mojang changes the textures.)

📥 Installation

1. Download the texture pack (.zip).
2. Open Minecraft Java Edition.
3. Go to Options → Resource Packs.
4. Click Open Pack Folder.
5. Move the downloaded .zip file into the folder.
6. Enable the pack and click Done.

⚠️ Report Issues

Found a bug or texture problem? Please report it with:

- Minecraft version
- Screenshot (if possible)
- A short description of the issue

Your feedback helps improve future updates!

❤️ Credits

Created by AyonPlayz.

Thank you for downloading SMP Texture Pack. Have fun and enjoy your adventure!
